This document details the special Inspection, which must be performed after I sc >
500KA,

The first draft initiated by 
Eng. Samer Ayad Bahga, at 
Saptia1 220kv Substation, Cairo

items: A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Ensure that
the CB isolated completely and grounded on both sides,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses

Change Remote
position to Local,

Shut off air
valves,

Remove DC
plugs for each pole,
Discharge air from tank
Check SF6 pressure on manometer. (7 bar)
Check air pressure on manometer. (10 bar)

Check
compressed air manometer with control instrument.

Check SF6
manometer with control instrument.
Check adjustment and function of manometer contacts.

Check SF6
moisture content (desired level <20 o 
 C).

Check SF6 air
contents (desired level <2%).

Check SF6 acid
content (desired level <5-10 PPmg )
Check adjustment and function of compressed air pressure switch.

Check fixed main contacts and if necessary
replace (1,2).

Check movable main contacts and if necessary
replace (1,2).

Check insulating nozzle and if necessary
replace (1,2).
Replace molecular sieve filter (1).
Carryout test switching operations.

Require
opening of gas compartment.

Random check on circuit breaker with max
operating duty further check only on negative result.
